portal_description:
With FUSE it is possible to implement a fully functional file system in a
user-space program. These packages contain the FUSE user-space tools to
mount a FUSE file system.

The fuse packages have been updated to ensure correct operation on Power little endian or ARM 64-bit hardware architectures. (BZ#1023785)

Users of fuse are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.

abstract:
With FUSE it is possible to implement a fully functional file system in a
user-space program. These packages contain the FUSE user-space tools to
mount a FUSE file system.

The fuse packages have been updated to ensure correct operation on Power little endian or ARM 64-bit hardware architectures. (BZ#1023785)

Users of fuse are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
